char_captions.char_caption: solo, robot, no humans, non-humanoid robot, mecha, robot joints, full body, transparent background, shadow. ONE heavy BIPEDAL combat robot carrying THREE SEPARATE weapon systems simultaneously. Most prominent is a large short thick GRENADE HOWITZER projecting upward from its BACK above its shoulder, a separate artillery tube with a very large dark round muzzle, visibly mounted to the back by a reinforced recoil bracket. BELOW that cannon, its RIGHT ARM is a completely different long slim belt-fed MACHINE GUN with a perforated barrel jacket and dangling ammunition belt. Its LEFT ARM is a powerful hydraulic demolition PINCER with two curved steel jaws. Show all THREE distinct weapons clearly: high shoulder artillery tube, lower arm machine gun, opposite arm melee pincer. Broad sloped box torso with a red optical eye, exactly two massive reverse-jointed hydraulic legs and broad feet, thick dark industrial armor with yellow warning stripes. Three meter tall, heavy and threatening, whole robot inside image with margin above the cannon and below both feet. Three-quarter full body view, diffuse front lighting, transparent background. No human crew, no wheels, no tracks.
